items.d: Protocol, sampling plan, phase reports, alert and action levels. Use from phase 2, after at least 2 weeks (WHO TRS 1033).

items.q: Can the builder also qualify the system?
items.a: Yes, under your control. We draft the protocols and reports; [executing staff: own engineers or named partner] execute them. Your quality unit approves each protocol before it runs and each report after. EU good manufacturing practice (GMP) Annex 15, 2.6, asks your site to confirm a supplier's protocols before approval.

items.q: Can we buy one stage only?
items.a: [services sold separately, yes or no]. Each service has its own first step and its own documents.

items.q: Do you work on other makers' systems?
items.a: For [makes and equipment types serviced]: service and upgrades, starting with a condition survey or an assessment.

items.q: How long from URS to water released?
items.a: Design takes [design to DQ, weeks], fabrication [approved design to FAT, weeks] and the factory acceptance test [FAT duration, days]. Installation and site acceptance take [installation and SAT, days], then [IQ/OQ on site, days] of qualification testing. Under WHO TRS 1033, water can be used after at least 2 weeks of sampling, with your quality unit's approval. Sampling continues for a year.
